title: 🌐 TXRP OFFICIAL WEBSITE IS NOW LIVE!
content:
🌐 TXRP OFFICIAL WEBSITE IS NOW LIVE!

We’re excited to announce that the official Texas State Roleplay website is now online and fully operational! 🎉

You can now visit the website to stay up to date with TXRP announcements, departments, rules, events, and other community information all in one place.

🔗[click here](https://htxrp-website-production.up.railway.app/)

🐛 Found a Bug?
If you notice any bugs, broken features, errors, or anything that doesn't look right, please report it through in <#1506838227741446216>  so our team can investigate and resolve the issue.

Thank you for being part of Texas State Roleplay! 🤠
— TXRP Staff Team
author: jaked0895
